result.title: ORBIT: Autoregressive Time Series Generation via Next Frequency-Band Prediction
result.summary: Deep generative models provide an effective modern solution to alleviating the problem of data scarcity by synthesizing realistic time series. However, despite the considerable progress achieved by existing deep time series generators, two key challenges remain: (1) learning hierarchical representations for heterogeneous temporal patterns; and (2) coordinating the generation process of heterogeneous temporal dynamics. To address these key bottlenecks, in this work, we propose ORBIT, a unified deep generative framework for time series. Specifically, we develop two key components: the Frequency-Hierarchical VQ-VAE (FH-VQ-VAE) and the Frequency-Band Autoregressive Transformer (FBAR). The former learns hierarchical representations by decomposing latent temporal representations into different frequency bands and applying residual quantization with increasing token budgets. The latter establishes a novel low-to-high frequency autoregressive direction, yielding a time series generation process that first constructs global temporal structures and then incrementally incorporates fine-grained temporal details. These compact designs not only disentangle heterogeneous temporal patterns for more effective representation learning but also mitigate potential interference among different temporal dynamics during generation. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging real-world benchmarks demonstrate that ORBIT achieves state-of-the-art overall performance while exhibiting superior inference efficiency compared with advanced baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ORBIT 时间序列生成框架：用频率分层 VQ-VAE 把潜表示分解到不同频带并以递增 token 预算做残差量化，再由低频到高频的自回归 Transformer 完成生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 非视觉推理工作，但其「先建全局结构、再补细粒度细节」的频率分层潜状态与递增 token 预算，可能为 LVR 的分层 latent 表示、生成顺序与计算容量分配提供可供核查的方法线索。
